description: §8.1.2 (S456) — a program-body `?{}` holding two `;`-separated statements is E-SQL-MULTIPLE-STATEMENTS. Each INSERT alone is admitted DML (§14.8.10 item (1)); before S456 the chain compiled clean and was sent as one string, and every driver ran both statements somewhere (Postgres' simple-query protocol; the SQLite adapter after a row-less first statement). The S239 r5 review executed the class on PG16: `SELECT set_config('scrml.tenant','B',true); select …` re-pinned the tenant inside the §14.8.11 tier transaction.
rationale: §8.1.2 (ruling user-voice-scrml.md S456 "one statement per seams reasonable. push"): in a compilation with a database, a program-body `?{}` SHALL hold exactly one SQL statement; a `;` outside a literal, comment or `${…}` slot followed by any further token is E-SQL-MULTIPLE-STATEMENTS.
